description:
Fetch Open Graph metadata, HTML-inferred tags, and hybrid social preview data for any URL via the OpenGraph.io API (v3). Returns og:title, og:description, og:image, og:type, favicon, and more, merged from three sources: raw Open Graph tags (`openGraph`), HTML-inferred fallbacks (`htmlInferred`), and a best-of hybrid (`hybridGraph`). Use `hybridGraph` as your primary source — it fills gaps automatically.

Pick the right tool:
  getOgData        → Open Graph tags, social preview metadata (title, description, image, favicon)
  getOgMarkdown    → Clean readable text / article prose — ideal for feeding into an LLM
  getOgScrapeData  → Raw HTML — use when you need to do your own parsing or link extraction
  getOgExtract     → Targeted elements by tag (html_elements) or named CSS selectors (selectors)
  getOgScreenshot  → Visual capture of a page as an image
  getOgQuery       → Natural-language question answered from page content (100–200 credits/request)

accept_lang.description: Accept-Language header for the outbound request. Use 'auto' to mirror the caller's language. Defaults to 'auto'.

ai_sanitize.description: Scan the fetched content for prompt-injection attempts before returning it.

ai_sanitize_mode.description: 'sanitize' cleans the content, 'warn' returns it with a safety report, 'block' returns HTTP 422 when risk_score >= 0.7.

auto_proxy.description: Automatically escalate to a proxy if the direct request fails. Defaults to true on v3.

auto_render.description: Automatically detects JS-heavy / SPA pages and re-fetches with browser rendering when needed. Enabled by default on v3 — leave unset unless you want to disable it. For guaranteed JS execution on every request use full_render: true instead.

cache_ok.description: Use cached results. Set to false to bypass cache and get fresh data. Defaults to true.

full_render.description: Forces a full browser execution pass on every request regardless of page type. Use when auto_render hasn't produced the content you expected, or when you need guaranteed JavaScript execution. Slower than auto_render — prefer auto_render for most cases.

load_more_clicks.description: Number of times to click the load_more_selector (1–10). Defaults to 3.

load_more_item_selector.description: CSS selector to watch for new items when using load_more_selector.

load_more_scroll.description: Scroll between load_more clicks. Defaults to true.

load_more_selector.description: CSS selector for a 'load more' button to click before extraction. Forces full_render.

load_more_wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after each load_more click (0–5000). Defaults to 1500.

max_cache_age.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds. Results older than this will be re-fetched. Defaults to 432000000 (5 days).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (1–4). Defaults to 4.

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for geo-targeted proxy exit node (e.g. 'US', 'GB').

retry.description: Automatically retry failed requests with escalating proxy tiers. Defaults to true on v3.

retry_escalate.description: Escalate proxy tier on each retry attempt. Defaults to true.

scroll_to_bottom.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page before extraction. Useful for lazy-loaded content. Forces full_render.

url.description: URL of the webpage to analyze.

use_ai.description: Enhance the metadata response with AI-generated fields. Requires an AI-enabled plan.

use_premium.description: Route the request through a premium proxy.

use_proxy.description: Route the request through a standard proxy.

use_superior.description: Route the request through a superior-tier proxy.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting data. Forces full_render.

name: getOgData

hybridGraph.description: Best-of merged metadata from all sources

requestInfo.description: Request metadata (cache status, version, options echo)
